environment.gpu_claim: virtio or other guest graphics; not native Asahi

cases.requirement: Confirm actual M3 host, UTM virtualized aarch64 Fedora KDE, read-only guest audit
Observe guest KDE Plasma login and desktop on the M3 UTM VM
Record three cold boot timings and five-minute idle CPU/memory measurements for stock KDE
Apply/review Nemesis KDE palette and Plasma Style with before and after guest screenshots
Show all eight SVG objects decoded and visible in a real Plasma widget window
Demonstrate hover, pointer selection, keyboard Tab Space Enter, cyan accent, strong focus and reset
Inspect Nemesis panel/widgets/labels at 100 percent guest scaling without clipping
Inspect Nemesis panel/widgets/labels at 200 percent guest scaling without clipping
Inspect readable Konsole colors and appropriate application menu icon fallbacks
Record stock-vs-Nemesis idle/resource deltas with units and sample count
Remove widget, restore saved KDE settings, uninstall managed assets, confirm original guest appearance

optional_cases.requirement: Compare optional browser display of aircraft globe after baseline; do not assert ARM64 wallpaper binary or native layer-shell integration
Native Fedora Asahi M3 graphics/driver/energy tests require new explicit GO; not part of this VM pass

report_contract.vm_profile: vCPU RAM disk resolution and display class
report_contract.samples: three boot observations and idle CPU memory with units
report_contract.per_case: id, status, observed_at_utc, evidence_refs, actual, expected
report_contract.overall: PASS only when every required case passes with real evidence, otherwise FAIL/BLOCKED/NOT_RUN
